start.title: Build your Business Profile
start.description: Eight questions about your business. Every other toolkit uses your answers to fill itself in.

series.name: RevOps
series.promise: Catch every lead, answer it fast, see your pipeline, and measure what your marketing actually does.

toolkits.title: Is Every Lead Reaching Your CRM?
toolkits.description: Six quick answers about your website forms. You get a map of where leads slip between the form and the first reply, and the fixes in the order to make them.

toolkits.title: Never Let a Lead Go Cold
toolkits.description: Five quick answers about how you follow up a new inquiry. You get a ready-to-build workflow, the emails written for you, and the HubSpot steps for your plan.

toolkits.title: Who Should Own Each New Lead?
toolkits.description: Six quick answers about your sales team. You get a routing model, your rules drafted in order, and the HubSpot steps to build them on your plan.

toolkits.title: Which Sales Steps Should Run Themselves?
toolkits.description: Six quick answers about your deal pipeline. You get the rep hours lost to admin, and a stage-by-stage build sheet for the automations that win them back.

toolkits.title: How Much Time Is Your Sales Process Wasting?
toolkits.description: Six quick answers about how new leads move through your business. You get the hours your team loses to hand work, and a ranked list of what to automate first.

toolkits.title: Is Your Pipeline Ready for a Dashboard?
toolkits.description: Five quick answers about how you report on your pipeline. You get what the spreadsheet costs, whether your data is ready, and the exact dashboard to build in its place.

toolkits.title: Can You See What Your Marketing Does?
toolkits.description: Check your tracking stack: Tag Manager, GA4, consent, ad tags and where leads land. You get an install-order build list for your website platform and a test-it checklist.

series.headline: Catch every lead.

series.name: Paid Media
series.promise: Get your Google Ads account ready, track the conversions that matter, then launch the right first campaign.

toolkits.title: Is Your Google Ads Account Ready?
toolkits.description: Check accounts, access, tracking, landing pages and feeds before launch. You get a readiness list of the gaps that would waste spend.

toolkits.title: Which Conversions Should You Track?
toolkits.description: Tell us how you make money. You get a named event plan, which ones should steer your ad bids, and what to send back to Google Ads from your CRM.

toolkits.title: Which Campaigns Should You Run First?
toolkits.description: Your first one or two campaigns, a start-tight structure, a budget split and what to check each week for the first month.

series.headline: Ready before you spend.

series.name: SEO
series.promise: Make sure Google and AI search can find, read and trust your site before anyone writes a word.

toolkits.title: Can Google Find and Trust Your Site?
toolkits.description: Check Search Console, indexing, crawler access, speed and trust signals. You get a foundation fix list in order.

toolkits.title: Is Your Business Ready for Local Search?
toolkits.description: For businesses with locations or a service area. You get a Google Business Profile and local checklist, plus a review request you can copy.

toolkits.title: Does Google and AI Know Who You Are?
toolkits.description: Check your Knowledge Panel, NAP consistency, Organization schema and About page. You get an entity health score and a ranked fix list, with a copyable schema snippet.

toolkits.title: How Exposed Are You to AI Overviews?
toolkits.description: Check answer-first formatting, FAQ structure, schema and content freshness. You get an exposure read and a ranked fix list with a before/after example.

toolkits.title: Can AI Bots Actually Read Your Site?
toolkits.description: Check robots.txt, llms.txt, rendering, sitemaps, speed and gating against the named AI crawlers. You get a readiness grade and a ranked technical fix list, with a copyable robots.txt snippet.

series.headline: Be found by Google and AI search.

series.name: Digital PR
series.promise: Be ready the day a journalist or podcast says yes: spokesperson, bios, topics and a media kit.

toolkits.title: Are You Ready to Be Pitched?
toolkits.description: Check spokesperson, availability, approvals, story and assets. You get a pitch-ready checklist and a 90-day prep plan.

toolkits.title: Build Your Media Kit
toolkits.description: Answer a few questions about your spokesperson. You get short and long bios, a podcast intro, talking points and a press kit outline.

series.headline: Ready when the press calls.

series.name: Email Marketing
series.headline: Land in the inbox.
series.promise: Reach the inbox, automate the emails that should send themselves, and know whether your program is working.

toolkits.title: Will Your Emails Reach the Inbox?
toolkits.description: Check your sending domain, SPF, DKIM, DMARC, unsubscribe and consent. You get an inbox readiness list in fix order for your email platform.

toolkits.title: Which Emails Should Send Themselves?
toolkits.description: Tell us how you sell. You get the automated flows to build first, with triggers, timing, subject lines and a first email drafted for you.

toolkits.title: Is Your Email Program Working?
toolkits.description: Enter a few numbers from your last campaigns. You get a scorecard of what's healthy, what to watch, and the three fixes to make first.

series.name: Strategy
series.promise: Step back before you build: check your market and business situation, see what you already have and who buys, map where your marketing money goes, and balance the three motions.
series.headline: Know what to do first.

toolkits.title: Are You Solving the Right Problem?
toolkits.description: Read your market situation and your business situation from quick answers, sharpened with real numbers if you have them, and get your next three priorities. Every number links to a free tool that gives it.
toolkits.review: Coby, Oct 22: market and business situation, optional real numbers. Check the thresholds that turn numbers into answers, the base depths and the tie-break rule of thumb.

toolkits.title: What Do You Already Have?
toolkits.description: Who buys from you, what drives them and what you already have to build on, in the order to fix it. Credits work you've done instead of starting over.
toolkits.review: Coby, Oct 22: added who buys and what drives them, feeding the gap ranking. Does the layer order and the usable-means test match the Gap Audit?

toolkits.title: How Do You Go to Market?
toolkits.description: List where your marketing money goes, walk through how buyers find and choose you, and see where spend and the journey don't line up. Includes a first draft of your positioning and messaging.
toolkits.review: Coby, Oct 22: Brand became Go to Market (spend inventory and customer journey), with the messaging starter kept. Check the channel-to-stage and channel-to-motion mapping.

toolkits.title: Do People Notice, Choose and Recommend You?
toolkits.description: Check your activities in all three motions: Notice Different, Align to Genuine and Recommend Delight. See which one is thinnest and what to fix first, including ethical ways to ask for reviews and referrals.
toolkits.review: Coby, Oct 22: Delight expanded to the ND, AG and RD buckets of activities. Are these the right activities in each bucket?

roadmap.title: Your Marketing Roadmap
roadmap.description: Your next three priorities from the Business Profile, the strategy starters and the toolkits you have used, each with the reason it was picked.
